question: How can the supreme reality be described as untouched by the six qualities while appearing as eunuch, woman, and man?
premises: The reality is untouched by six qualities.
It appears as eunuch, woman, and man.
inference: The absolute transcends qualities and gender while manifesting in every form.
uncertainties: The six qualities are not specified in this verse.
The exact referent of the description is not explicit.
plain_english: Untouched by the six qualities, it is likewise eunuch, woman, and man.
